name: Staff of Fire
description: A staff of blackened wood capped with brass shaped like a flame.
attuned_by: by a druid, sorcerer, warlock, or wizard
body:
## What it does

Flame struggles to harm the one who holds it, and its charges call fire up.

## Charges

It holds ten and regains 1d6 + 4 each dawn. Spend the last and it may burn away to nothing.

charges.last: roll a d20; on a 1 it blackens, crumbles into cinders and is gone
